dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave spline curvature near the base, transitioning to a near-linear vertical ascent toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a sharp morphological point and minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.0:1.3 ratio of visible base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear white depigmented scratches and crisscrossing marks visible on the dorsal ridge anterior to the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-density distribution of small circular white speckles across the entire visible epidermal region.
